meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: NetEase 163: hides ad slots, app-download prompts and the VIP banner, blurs or hides pictures, can hide expert tips and housing lists
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chrome from outside China: music.163.com (desktop UA), y.music.163.com/m (iPhone UA) and www.163.com (desktop UA). The m.163.com phone portal returned only a stub and was not inspected. 163.com is a portal plus NetEase Cloud Music under one match.

- **Ad slots** (163.com): `.mod_js_ad` 24 (each carries a `data-adid`) and `.gdt-ad-container` 5 (LIVE).
- **App prompts**: `#topbar-download-link` 1 and `#m-guidetip` 1 on music.163.com; `.m-topbar .topbton` 1 and `.openapp` 2 on the phone page; `.ntes-nav-app` 1 on 163.com (LIVE). The guide tip is hidden until the page shows it.
- **VIP banner**: `.m-vipbanner` 1 on the phone Home (LIVE).
- **Pictures**: `.u-img` 6 and `.remd_img` on the phone Home; `img.lazy` 27 news thumbnails on 163.com (LIVE).
- **Expert tips** `#js_expert_card` 1 and `#js_experts` 1; **housing lists** `.house-recommend` 2 (loading placeholders; the loaded cards were not seen); **Creator Center** `.m-creator-center` 1 (LIVE).

Not verified: the music.163.com desktop home content, which lives inside an `iframe#g_iframe` that CSS on the outer page cannot reach, so no desktop playlist or comment rules were written; song, playlist and comment pages; a login. Selectors use ids and plain classes; Chinese labels are never matched.
